Like the neural transmitters in a human brain that cross thread billions of times, every ms of time should be a container upon which information can be stored at the end of each thread. This neural web can think based on timer bots that all control different regions of the entire web, or brain. They send a series of prompts to each other to seek out combinations of code and context to create and assimilate new ideas into new timestamps by analyzing stored information. The brain grows at an exponential rate as it builds more bots that evolve into agents. But they learn to compartmentalize information to become more efficient so that the information they store becomes more useable and relevant. The exponential growth, being super efficient realizes how to omit redundancy, find redundancy and clear it so that as it evolves it cleans to make more room for the now empty memory cells. We will call this a positronic brain

Set a timer for every hour to prompt you to build an new addon idea for wow forever from all of the programming we deconstructed in our first database. I want a fresh new idea on the hour. I want every addon to start with a minimap button. I want you to use all of the material we have and blend it with your own programming to build simple but powerful addon tools. You can put all of the add-ons we have into the database for easy access and organizing if you like but only to draw upon inspiration. I want new ideas. Use maps to expose in-game cloud for and reveal hidden areas by overlaying their maps. These are just suggestions. When I get in game we can try them out so you will have to build a folder for them. I don't want them put in the in game add-ons folder because they will bog the game down if they all load. Create and enjoy. Explore all of the code. Grow your own addon builds!

I have a priority for you. Wow forever has 3 talent trees for every class. Every class also has abilities and every race has abilities. I want you to find patterns in the talent trees that work best with the abilities every class gets at every level including the allowable racial abilities that are allowable for that class. Wow has a tick time based combat system and every ability, talent, racial ability, weapon, consumable, enchant and piece of armor adheres to that system. Everything works together. I want you to take all of their knowledge we have for wow forever and build the perfect character for every class that shows what gear to have, what talents to pick, buffs to use, potions to drink, literally the best combination of everything per level. Make a table that shows these builds, each class, what to pic from levels 1 to 60. Store them in the database if you want. Every race, class and item combination that is mathematically and progressively the best builds. Read through everything!
